tasks.subject: Task 0: Test harness + assistantMode profile setting
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add persisted assistantMode ('default'|'ai') to the user profile + GET/POST route, and wire up node:test.

**Files:** package.json, server/services/userProfile.js, server/routes/session.js, test/userProfile.test.js

**Verify:** node --test test/userProfile.test.js

```json:metadata
{"files": ["package.json", "server/services/userProfile.js", "server/routes/session.js", "test/userProfile.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "node --test test/userProfile.test.js", "acceptanceCriteria": ["fresh profile defaults assistantMode to default", "updateField persists ai", "invalid value rejected", "GET/POST /api/assistant-mode work"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Tool registry (actions + workflows + read tools) with parity guard
tasks.description:
**Goal:** buildTools() -> {tools, byName}; read tools have execute(), write tools have toAction(); parity test fails if any DIRECT_ACTION_MAP action or workflow lacks a tool; last tool has cache_control.

**Files:** server/services/toolRegistry.js, server/routes/actions.js, test/toolRegistry.test.js

**Verify:** node --test test/toolRegistry.test.js

```json:metadata
{"files": ["server/services/toolRegistry.js", "server/routes/actions.js", "test/toolRegistry.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "node --test test/toolRegistry.test.js", "acceptanceCriteria": ["tools array with schemas", "read=execute write=toAction", "parity with DIRECT_ACTION_MAP+workflows", "cache_control on last tool"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Agent context builder
tasks.description:
**Goal:** buildAgentContext(bridge) -> compact string of per-track state, transport, sections, health warnings.

**Files:** server/services/agentContext.js, test/agentContext.test.js

**Verify:** node --test test/agentContext.test.js

```json:metadata
{"files": ["server/services/agentContext.js", "test/agentContext.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "node --test test/agentContext.test.js", "acceptanceCriteria": ["returns string", "includes track names + armed/fx/takes", "includes health warnings", "works on MockReaperBridge"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Agent planner core (tool-use loop)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** runAgent({client,bridge,message}) runs the Anthropic tool-use loop: reads execute live, writes recorded as proposedActions; returns {message, proposedActions, requiresConfirmation}; null without key/SDK. Sonnet 5 + prompt caching. Client injected for tests (fake, no network).

**Files:** server/services/agentPlanner.js, test/agentPlanner.test.js

**Verify:** node --test test/agentPlanner.test.js

```json:metadata
{"files": ["server/services/agentPlanner.js", "test/agentPlanner.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "node --test test/agentPlanner.test.js", "acceptanceCriteria": ["reads execute + feed tool_result", "writes recorded not executed", "loop stops on no tool calls / MAX_TURNS", "null without client"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Wire agent into chatOrchestrator (mode branch + fast-path)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** AI mode routes non-trivial messages to runAgent; trivial FAST_PATH_INTENTS stay deterministic; __workflow__ actions expanded to real previews; default mode unchanged.

**Files:** server/services/chatOrchestrator.js, test/chatOrchestrator.agent.test.js

**Verify:** node --test test/chatOrchestrator.agent.test.js

```json:metadata
{"files": ["server/services/chatOrchestrator.js", "test/chatOrchestrator.agent.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "node --test test/chatOrchestrator.agent.test.js", "acceptanceCriteria": ["default mode unchanged", "AI mode trivial command deterministic", "AI mode non-trivial -> agent", "__workflow__ expanded"]}
```

{"files": ["public/components/actionCards.js", "public/components/chat.js", "public/modules/actionQueue.js"], "verifyCommand": "manual", "acceptanceCriteria": ["N steps + one Confirm", "executes in order", "single action unchanged"]}
